51/G.goal: Apply cybersickness-aware optimization to semi-interactive VR tours by formulating exposure-limited path problems and solving the minimum-time all-POI case as a time-weighted travelling salesman problem.
51/G.achieves: Give the learner a foundational method for reducing cybersickness through VR navigation-time optimization, supporting the course's aim to design and implement optimized XR systems.

51/O1.goal: Formulate the VR navigation optimization problem by linking cybersickness exposure duration to minimum-time all-POI and maximum-POI-within-time-limit tour objectives.
51/O1.achieves: Let the learner frame VR user-experience optimization around cybersickness and identify the path-planning targets needed before selecting an optimization method.

51/O2.goal: Solve the minimum-time all-POI VR navigation problem by converting a POI graph into a time-weighted travelling salesman problem and using natural walking-speed estimates to recover a valid path within cybersickness exposure limits.
51/O2.achieves: Let the learner compute a time-minimizing navigation path for a VR tour and apply graph-based optimization to reduce cybersickness in XR system development.
